meta.name: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
meta.description: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

videos.title: I Was a Faceless, Evil NPC Heiress
videos.overview: A recently dumped budding paleobotanist finds herself reincarnated as a background character in an otome game.

videos.title: Tea Party with the Love Interests

videos.title: The Overprotective, Cunning Fiancé
videos.overview: Pia receives an unexpected visit from Uncle Johnny, who gives her a job offer that sounds too good to be true.

videos.title: The Timid Villain and the Outgoing Heroine
videos.overview: With Pia stressing out about Caroline's appearance, Rufus decides to take her out on their first proper date.

videos.title: A Gameplay Item and the Heroine's Secret
